faq.q: Which plan should we start with?
faq.a: If your site mainly needs to stay fast, secure and up to date, start with Essentials. If it should bring in leads or sales, Growth is the usual starting point. Not sure? The free audit ends with a plan recommendation.
Yes. You can move up or down from the next billing month, without a new contract.

faq.q: What if we need more hours in one month?
faq.a: Add extra hours at the add-on rates, or move up a plan if it happens regularly — that is usually cheaper.
After the minimum three months, the plan ends at the end of the month you cancel. You keep everything: code, content, accounts and documentation.

faq.q: Do you sign an NDA and a data processing agreement?
faq.a: Yes. We sign your NDA on request, and a data processing agreement (DPA) is part of every plan.
Yes — new websites, shops, migrations and larger AI projects run as a Custom project with a fixed quote, and can move to a monthly plan after launch.
